purpose: Learn a shorter sampler separately from pose-label experiments
teacher: Inherited student 25-step CFG2, layer80, FP32, final layer normalization
coupling: Identical endpoint draws; paired arm uses recorded input noise, independent arm draws fresh Gaussian noise. Both consume identical time/dropout RNG.
training: Matched initialization, seed, optimizer and 2000 updates; evaluate 500 and 2000
evaluation: 5 and 10 steps, CFG1; decoded quality, validity and frozen ensemble coverage against original 25-step CFG2 baseline
promotion: Require preserved quality and coverage plus measured >=2x K32 speedup over inherited student; report direct teacher latency
test: Reserved confirmation and original test remain unscored
